verdict.rationale: The firm documents client-facing secure portals: Catalyze (client-exclusive community platform with tools, legal team access, events) and GDHQ ('secure platform that offers easy access to your company's key corporate records,' including DIY contract generator and SMART Request intake forms), plus the D&O Questionnaire Portal for document workflows. These cover secure access to records/documents and status-like intake tools, but there's no explicit documentation of matter-status tracking or a unified 'matters' dashboard. missing for 10: explicit matter-status tracking features, independent corroboration of portal security architecture, more detail on document management within GDHQ.
